Question: A 32-year-old male asks his physician for information regarding a vasectomy. On further questioning, you learn that he and his wife have just had their second child and he asserts that they no longer wish to have additional pregnancies. You ask him if he has discussed a vasectomy with his wife to which he replies, "Well, not yet, but I'm sure she'll agree." What is the next appropriate step prior to scheduling the patient's vasectomy?

Options:
opa. Insist that the patient first discuss this procedure with his wife
opb. Telephone the patient's wife to inform her of the plan
opc. Explain the risks and benefits of the procedure and request signed consent from the patient
opd. Refuse to perform the vasectomy
ope. Explain the risks and benefits of the procedure and request signed consent from the patient and his wife
